goal: Hide Qt6 advertisements and remove reserved footer layout without cropping the native window.
constraints: Preserve the existing resource lifetime and discovery polling fixes.
Keep classic native ad hiding functional without Node/Frida.
Use portable optional runtime paths and GUI-thread Qt property changes.
Do not change KakaoTalk files, user data or system network configuration.
decisions: Recognize owned Qt6 ad windows and the AdFit NAS Advertisement title.
Remove clipping and frame modifications from the Qt6 ad-hiding path.
Exclude the verified AdBanner loader and separator from ColumnLayout.
Bundle or explicitly select Node and Frida; no REA/Codex installation is required.
Validate x64, Qt 6.10.3 and the component hierarchy before layout changes.
verified_results: The local prototype expanded the content area to the full window height and moved the lower sidebar icons down.
The local prototype preserved the native frame and unchanged KakaoTalk process/executable.
The local prototype cleaned up its old helper and reapplied the layout after blocker restart.
go test ./... passed, including runtime discovery and existing resource regression tests.
Windows amd64, 386 and arm64 builds passed.
JavaScript syntax checks passed for the agent, helper and runtime packaging script.
The pinned runtime installed with npm ci and the packaging script produced a portable Windows x64 Node/Frida runtime.
The bundled runtime loaded Frida and resolved the running KakaoTalk executable path with NODE_PATH cleared.
limitations: Live layout verification covers KakaoTalk 26.9.0.420 with Qt 6.10.3 on Windows x64.
